name: TrustPrinciples
texts: How we workVerify everything yourself.Every figure on this site traces back to a primary source you can open and read.Read our sourcing standards →01Primary sources firstCampaign filings, voting records, and official statements outrank secondhand summaries.02Multiple models, one recordIndependent AI reviewers cross-check research before it's published.03Corrections are publicWhen a claim is wrong, the fix and the reason are logged in the open.04Nonpartisan by designEvery candidate on a ballot gets the same research treatment.

Our editorial promiseDon't take our word for it.Read the evidence, see where it disagrees, and decide for yourself.Examine our methodology →01Every claim links to a sourceFollow the research back to candidate statements, public records, and reputable reporting.02Uncertainty stays visibleSparse evidence, conflicting accounts, and confidence levels are part of the record—not hidden in fine print.03No endorsements. Ever.We organize evidence consistently across parties. The judgment about what matters remains yours.
